title: campanula rotundifolia var. farinulenta
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. farinulenta, commonly known as Hairy Bellflower or Powdered Bellflower, is a subspecies of the Campanula rotundifolia plant. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia var. farinulenta include acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating coughs, colds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
